subject: Post-demo follow-up — confirm funding owner & procurement path
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Stevens <lauren.stevens@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up — confirm funding owner & procurement path

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for your time today and for walking us through the clinical workflow. Quick recap and ask so we can keep momentum: 

1) Next steps we agreed: short pilot (4-week) scoped to 3 clinics + security review + procurement/finance alignment.
2) I attached a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) with deliverables and timing so procurement has a clear inbound doc.
3) A key outstanding item for scheduling pilot procurement is confirmation of the funding owner and procurement contact at Veridian. You mentioned finance would ultimately sign off — could you introduce the appropriate finance contact (and procurement if separate)?

If helpful, we can prepare a one-page ROI summary tailored to finance (cost-savings / FTE equivalent) to shorten the approval loop — Marissa (cc'd) can craft that once we have the right contact.

Attachments: [Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [Attachment: redwood_security_qs_filled.pdf (application/pdf)]

Proposed times for a 30-min connect with finance/procurement: Tue 3/14 10–11am PT, Wed 3/15 8–11am PT. If those don't work, suggest two windows and we’ll adapt.

Appreciate the intro — happy to jump on a call with Susan/Procurement when you loop them in.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego: (415) 555-0192
https://www.redwoodinference.com
From: Lauren Stevens <lauren.stevens@veridianhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Simon Jackson <simon.jackson@veridianhealth.com>, procurement@veridianhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — confirm funding owner & procurement path

Diego — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Good call today.

I am the product lead for the pilot but I do not control the budget. Finance will own the budget approval and Procurement runs contracting. I’ve looped in Simon (CIO) and our procurement inbox so the right folks see the MAP.

Simon / Procurement team — quick context: we ran a demo with Redwood today focused on clinical documentation assist. Diego attached a MAP and a security questionnaire; they suggested a short ROI one-pager for finance to accelerate approvals. Can someone confirm the appropriate finance approver (or give me the name and I’ll make the intro)?

FYI Susan Nguyen in Finance is usually the approver for emerging tech pilots — copying her on reply if you want to route directly.

I can also host a 30-min session next week for finance + procurement to talk timelines if that helps.

Thanks,
Lauren Stevens
Product Lead — Clinical Tools
Veridian Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo follow-up — confirm funding owner & procurement path

Diego — thanks for looping me in. Quick internal notes and suggested outreach plan: 

1) If Susan Nguyen is the approver, we'll send a finance-focused ROI one-pager + a short pricing note that maps to a 4-week pilot (monthly equivalent + pilot discount). I can draft that today and tag it "For Finance: Veridian ROI".
2) Procurement typically asks for: MAP, SOW language, data handling summary, and SOC2 evidence. We should surface the security PDF and include a short answers doc for common procurement Qs (I’ll create a Q&A stub).
3) Recommended sequencing: ask Lauren to introduce Susan and procurement; once intro happens we (Diego + Marissa) run a 30-min budget alignment call (finance + product + us). Then send updated MAP and pricing with SOW highlights.

I'll prepare: ROI one-pager (PDF), short procurement Q&A (doc), and the MAP with clarified milestones. Planning to share by EOD 3/13 PT so Diego can send once Lauren confirms the intro.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Proposed slots for the 30-minute budget alignment (finance + procurement + product + us): 
• Thu 3/16 9:30–10:00am PT
• Thu 3/16 3:00–3:30pm PT
• Fri 3/17 8:00–8:30am PT

Please pick one that works for Susan/Procurement or propose an alternate window. Once you introduce Susan/Procurement we’ll send the MAP + ROI + security Qs to their inbox and include a short calendar invite.
